falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5.0% above or at least 5.0% below its verdict-date close on any session within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: HOLD/UNKNOWN assumes no resolvable directional regime; a ±5% close-to-close move proves a trend was already in force and the hold was false

falsification_conditions.condition: CBOE VIX closes above 35 on any session, or closes below 13.0 on a day the S&P 500 also prints a 20-session closing high, within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either print leaves the ambiguous vol band consistent with an unresolved bottom_2024_aug analog; stress above 35 or complacent new highs would have required a non-HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls to 40% or below, on any daily update within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 38 and 78% bottom-analog match defined the unknown state; a blowoff-threshold breach or analog collapse shows that classification was already wrong

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
